items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Earl Coleman sang on 'Dark Shadows' and 'This is Always.'

ctx.x: Doc West, of course. I guess it's not funny, but all these guys are gone [NOT EARL COLEMAN IN 1982], and it seems like I'm still around just getting started. Well, I guess I always feel that way about music, you know, because if I should live to be 200 I'll never learn all there is to know. That's what makes it so interesting.
Did you learn anything in particular from any one of these artists?
